title: Late Funding Fee Rate Notice — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
**Rate.** The late funding fee of a Paystride Payroll Card Program is figured for the program's most recent regular payroll batch, the regular batch with the latest pay date. The late-fee charge is the late funding fee of the package held, and the late funding fee is that charge rounded half up to the cent.

**Order of the figures.** How the late-fee charge is figured is settled first, amounts added to the late-fee charge are added next, and the multipliers of the late-fee charge are applied to that sum last, before the rounding.

### Figures by package (illustration)

| Package held | Late-fee charge | Late funding fee |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | the Premier late funding fee, 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | the Elite late funding fee, 0.00 | 0.00 |

The figure is that of the package held: a hypothetical program that has moved from the Premier to the Elite package is figured at the Elite figure.
